_README: Configuration for trace-collector.py. The scoring/buffer subsystem was retired; the collector now only captures Claude Code auto-memory writes. All fields are optional - missing fields fall back to defaults baked into the hook. Fields starting with underscore are inline comments (JSON has no native comment syntax).
_comment_memory_dir_pattern: Regex matching the directory that holds Claude Code auto-memory topic files. Default targets the native auto-memory location ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/. Override only if autoMemoryDirectory is redirected to a non-standard path.
